title: Project stable score references for report artifacts
description:
Implement the production projection support required by story plx-2e4b79f2-947d-4959-81e7-206cba0f67a7.

Scope:
- Add a stable non-displayed score_ref to portfolio, priority, question/issue, feedback-investment, and optimization-outcome stakeholder rows.
- Derive it deterministically from the exact opaque score ID without displaying or exporting the raw ID.
- Keep scorecard_ref behavior unchanged.
- Add outside-in tests proving duplicate score display names remain distinguishable through the projection and raw opaque IDs do not enter displayed workbook cells.

No client-specific data, GraphQL schema changes, resource changes, or operational mutations.
